name: GOV.UK Tuberculosis tests for visa applicants
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: This page covers every UK visa type. A Student visa applicant comes to the UK for more than 6 months, so only the general rule for stays of 6 months or more applies: set tb_test_required=true with that rule (and the listed-countries residence requirement) in conditions. Never set tb_test_required=false because of exemptions or short-stay rules, and do not list documents for short stays, returning residents, family, BNO or child cases. The tuberculosis_test_certificate condition is exactly that general rule (coming for 6 months or more, lived in a listed country for 6 months or more, living there within the last 6 months); the paragraph about children seeing a clinician or having a chest x-ray describes the test procedure and is never a document condition.

name: 香港入境事务处 来港就读（中国香港）
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: Only extract requirements for a NEW application for entry for study: the 'Checklist of Forms and Documents to be Submitted' has three tables - (1) documents submitted by the applicant, (2) documents submitted by the sponsor, (3) documents for each accompanying dependant. Extract every row of tables (1) and (2), including rows that continue after a chunk boundary; never extract table (3) or any row that mentions 'the dependant'. Ignore extension-of-stay, dependant, internship and part-time work sections (their processing times and documents do not apply to a new student visa); the applicant's Hong Kong identity card and the current school letter listed under extension of stay are NOT documents for a new application. Items used only after approval (the e-Visa, the Mainland Exit-entry Permit (EEP) and its exit endorsement) are not application documents: never list them. Codes: ID 995A = application_form; ID 995B = other_document named 保证人申请表（ID 995B）; letter of acceptance = admission_letter; the APPLICANT's valid travel document = passport, required=true with no condition, quoting only 'Copy of the applicant's valid travel document containing personal particulars, date of issue, date of expiry' (its '(if applicable)' qualifies the re-entry visa details, not the document; the PRC resident identity card is an alternative for this item, never a separate document); the SPONSOR's travel document = other_document named 保证人旅行证件副本 (never passport); proof of the applicant's financial support = proof_of_funds; proof of the sponsor's financial standing with the sponsor's undertaking = financial_sponsorship_evidence. Use exactly these other_document names: proof of the applicant's accommodation arrangement = 住宿安排证明; the sponsor's accommodation undertaking = 保证人住宿承诺书; the sponsor's Hong Kong identity card = 保证人香港身份证副本; the Macao Visit Permit and Macao identity card = 澳门居民来往香港旅游证及澳门身份证副本; the Taiwan household registration transcript and Taiwan identity card = 台湾户籍誊本及台湾身份证副本. Use exactly these condition keys: '[if the applicant is under the age of 18]' -> {"applicant_under_18": true}; '[if the sponsor is the educational institution]' -> {"sponsor_is_educational_institution": true}; items marked '#' (not required if the sponsor is the educational institution granting the acceptance) -> {"sponsor_is_educational_institution": false}, quoting that footnote as condition_quote, and for the sponsor's travel document also "sponsor_is_hk_permanent_resident": false; '[for Macao SAR residents only]' -> {"applicant_residence": "Macao SAR"}; '[for Taiwan residents only]' -> {"applicant_residence": "Taiwan"}; the applicant's Hong Kong identity card '(if any)' in the new-application checklist -> other_document named 申请人香港身份证副本, required=true with condition {"holds_hk_identity_card": true}. Every conditional item above is required=true with its condition, never required=false. Rules specific to Chinese residents of the Mainland belong in conditions, not in applies_to_city.
notes: 中国香港入境事务处学生签证/进入许可：资格、申请材料（含经济状况证明）、审理时间；无统一生活费金额标准
